title: From Textual Information Sources to Linked Data in the Agatha Project
answer_short: The effectiveness of the pipeline approach is evaluated by its ability to populate an ontology with extracted events and link them to external referents, enabling complex queries and inferences to detect patterns of typical criminal actions.
answer_rationale: The evaluation of the pipeline's effectiveness is implied through its functional outcomes: populating an ontology with event data and linking it to external referents (e.g., Eurovoc and IATE), which allows for complex queries and inferences to detect criminal patterns. This is supported by the description of the pipeline’s purpose and its application in the Agatha project, as well as the mention of its modular design and comparison with other systems.
